description_sq:
Ofrojme per shitje apartament 2+1 ne kompleksin E-88 prane kupoles ne laprake.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 7 te nje prej godinave dhe ka siperfaqe totale 97 m2.
-Apartamenti orientohet nga jugu.
Organizohet ne:
-Korridor ne hyrje te apartamentit
-Salloni sebashku me kendin e gatimit dhe ngrenies
- Dy dhoma gjumi
-Tualet
-Ballkon
Kompleksi eshte i gatshem per banim.
description_en: We offer for sale a 2+1 apartment in the E-88 complex near the dome in Laprake. The apartment is located on the 7th floor of one of the buildings and has a total area of ​​97 m2. - The apartment faces south. It is organized in: -Corridor at the entrance of the apartment -Living room with cooking and dining area -Two bedrooms -Toilets -Balcony The complex is ready for living.
